IT Application Manager/in

Stellenbeschreibung:
ENGIE Germany stands for combined expertise in the transition to climate neutrality, offering comprehensive energy solutions and services ranging from plant engineering to carbon neutrality. More than 5,500 employees at 50 locations are already making a real difference when it comes to climate neutrality.  

How do we do that? For example, we develop and implement sustainable solutions in the areas of wind, solar, hydro, and energy storage. Or we plan and build process facilities for our customers in the energy and utilities sectors. Or we provide technical building management support for heating, plumbing, HVAC, and refrigeration systems. And so on. As you can see, we’re shaping the future of energy - together.   

Your tomorrow starts today! Join us in welcoming the future and become part of our success as 

IT Application Manager Robotron eSales (m/f/d)

**Location:** Berlin or Cologne

**Reference number:** 65000

We are looking for an experienced and proactive IT Application Manager for our EDM system eSales from Robotron. In this role, you will enable the business to use the EDM system efficiently, as well as manage the whole application and it’s interfaces.

As the central expert for robotron eSales, you will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external vendors to maintain high availability, optimize processes, and drive digital excellence.

Your responsibilities:

Application Ownership & Operations

- Serve as the primary application expert and strategic product owner for Robotron eSales, driving the product vision and roadmap
- Ensure stable, secure, and reliable daily operation of the solution, including incident, problem, and change management
- Coordinate maintenance, upgrades, and integrations in line with IT standards

Business Support & Enhancement

- Act as the key interface between business and technical teams
- Analyze business requirements, prioritize the product backlog, and translate them into technical specifications or user stories
- Manage enhancements, configurations, and system optimizations to support evolving business needs and maximize business value

Project & Vendor Management

- Lead or contribute to digitalization and automation initiatives leveraging Robotron eSales
- Take ownership of vendor management by effectively managing relationships with Robotron and other external service providers to ensure SLA fulfillment and timely feature delivery
- Support implementation projects, testing, and release cycles

Quality, Security & Compliance

- Ensure data quality, system documentation, and audit readiness
- Promote adherence to IT security, data protection, and compliance standards

Your profile:

- Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience
- Several years of proven experience as a Product Owner or Application Manager specifically with Robotron eSalesGood understanding of German and/or European energy market processes (e.g., billing, EDM, market communication)
- Hands-on knowledge of: - SQL databases
- Interfaces/API concepts (EDIFACT, AS4, REST)
- Application lifecycle management
- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive, customer-oriented approach
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively align with business leaders and external vendors
- Fluent in German and English

What We Offer You:

- **EXCITING EXTRAS:** Discounts, e-bikes, services, and technology from leading providers via our ENGIE platform.  
- **FAMILY AND CAREER:** Up to 150 € toward childcare or preschool fees.  
- **FLEXIBLE WORK:** At ENGIE, you get the flexibility you need to successfully complete your tasks.
- **MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR POTENTIAL:** Training sessions, workshops, and continuing education—do what helps you and us grow.    
- **YOUR PERFECT PLACE:** We support your internal transition to other divisions within ENGIE. 

We Embrace Diversity

At ENGIE, we are convinced that every talent plays an important role in accelerating the energy transition. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment where diversity is valued and each individual is supported.  

Our goal is to create a culture of collaboration and innovation where every employee can thrive and reach their full potential. 

We actively welcome applications that contribute to the diversity of our company. Every talent is welcome here—and, above all, valued equally! Regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or disability.  

**HELLO TOMORROW!** 

Your tomorrow starts today! Become part of our success with excellent career prospects and high recognition. Join us in shaping the transition to climate neutrality. We look forward to receiving your online application.   

**Your contact:**  

Stefanie Holscher Blackman

Talent Acquisition Partner

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

Are you ready to contribute your expertise to research and teaching while also advancing your own professional development? Then we are looking for you as a

Research assistant as part of a doctoral program
for the project „Explainable AI for the molecular bases of disease progression“

Department of Mathematics, Computer Science and Technology | Campus Remagen | Full-time (39 hours/week) | immediate start | limited until 31.08.2030 | Pay grade 13 TV-L (https://www.lff.rlp.de/fileadmin/user_upload/LFF/PDF/service/gehaltstabellen/TV-L/2026_04_01_Arbeitnehmer.pdf)

- close collaboration with interdisciplinary partners from the fields of medicine, biology and bioinformatics
